page_title: WER 1-2 RBL | Werder Bremen v RB Leipzig 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+8' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
90+6' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.

90+4' 1 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90+3' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
90+2' That's a clear yellow card. Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) goes into the book.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
87' This shall not pass! Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
86' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) replacing Yan Diomande.
86' That will be all from Christoph Baumgartner who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).

82' Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Maarten Vandevoordt is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
81' Golden chance! Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
80' Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
78' Substitution. Antonio Nusa makes way for Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
78' Substitution. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) has come on for Romulo Cardoso.
76' Daniel Thioune decides to make a substitution. Justin Njinmah will be replaced by Salim Musah (Werder Bremen).
76' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt did his best and is replaced by Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen).
73' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
70' Robert Hartmann interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen).
68' David Raum (RB Leipzig) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
68' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
65' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Here is a change. Marco Grull is going off and Daniel Thioune gives the last tactical orders to Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen).
61' Substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) in, Felix Agu out.

61' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
60' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
56' The substitution is prepared. Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Castello Lukeba.
56' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
54' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Hartmann blows for a foul.
52' 0 - 2 Goal! Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
51' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
49' Daniel Thioune is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) suffers an injury and Patrice Covic comes on.
47' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
46' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen).
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

43' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

41' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Maarten Vandevoordt pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
40' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
38' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle as Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
38' A corner kick by Werder Bremen is thwarted by the well prepared Maarten Vandevoordt (RB Leipzig).

37' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Maarten Vandevoordt has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Poor challenge! Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) is penalised for tripping and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle.

34' Great solo effort from Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
34' Close! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
33' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
30' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempts to find Romulo Cardoso, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
28' Antonio Nusa receives a short pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
25' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) meets a cross inside the box, but Mio Backhaus wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
23' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
21' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
20' Surely that's handball by one of the RB Leipzig players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
19' David Raum (RB Leipzig) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Antonio Nusa.
15' 0 - 1 Wonderful finish from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig). He drills a low shot precisely into the bottom left corner. No chance for the goalkeeper.

14' That was a nice football moment. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Maarten Vandevoordt guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Werder Bremen was in an offside position.
8' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
8' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

7' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
4' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) brings an opponent down and Robert Hartmann interrupts the game.
1' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Robert Hartmann was nominated as the referee for this game.
